summary: George Russell controlled the Azerbaijan Grand Prix from pole position through two late safety car restarts to repel Max Verstappen's final assault and secure Mercedes' first win of the season. Russell's flawless execution—marshalling tire degradation and executing restarts under intense pressure—delivered what he called his most dominant weekend, a statement after months of inconsistency. The victory pulls Mercedes within striking distance of the championship lead and hands momentum back to the silver arrows with five rounds remaining.
